mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 0.5pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue warnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS shows no negative correlation with S&P 500 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 106.0) indicates easing supply constraints that reduce input costs and boost corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 106.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE shows no negative correlation with S&P 500 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 104.0) signals worsening supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 104.0.
